--!strict
-- A script lives in the instance it is put in: this one is inside the part it
-- turns, so `script.Parent` is that part. It runs when you press Play.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Settings = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Settings"))

local part = script.Parent :: Part
local origin = part.CFrame.Position
local elapsed = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
    elapsed += delta
    part.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin) * CFrame.fromEuler(0, elapsed * Settings.SpinSpeed, 0)
end)

--!strict
-- A ModuleScript runs once, the first time something requires it, and returns
-- what the scripts that require it share. In ReplicatedStorage, any script can
-- reach it.

local Settings = {
    -- Radians per second.
    SpinSpeed = 1.5,
}

return Settings
